catalog.title: Seiko JDM Catalog No.1
catalog.note: JDM catalogue (セイコーウオッチカタログ '69 NO.1). Each caption prints the model name with the jewel count (石) except on Grand/King Seiko and the battery watch, then ● symbol + number with the (case–dial) code, e.g. ● 61GAW 010(800—802), ladies' ● 10QS R-106(007—020); ref = symbol-number in the site's JDM style (61GAW-010, 10QS-R-106), code = the printed line, caseDialCode = the bracketed code. A second number printed under it as 041(〃)和 is the same watch with a Japanese day wheel and is kept in code/notes, not as a separate record. Prices are list prices in yen per printed material/band line (SS, SGP, GC, STP, 14K・WG, 18K, WGP, WGF, PDP, APDP, ASGP, AWGP, AWGF, AGF, ACRP, PC; WP water-proof; MB metal bracelet, LB leather band — no bracelet part codes are printed); a few prices print the thousands separator as a full stop (10.500円) and are written with a comma. No case-movement (CCCC-NNNN) refs are printed; caliber is given only where the printed symbol is the movement itself (2559, 2539, 2519, 1944, 6159, 6117, 6618). Dial colours are read from the photos.
catalog.method: Vision transcription of 250 DPI renders (Oct 2026): every pictured watch was tied to its printed caption (text-layer ● anchors + grid cells, hand anchors where the bullet is missing) and ref, code, case–dial code, jewels, every price line, case, band and features were verified against full-resolution caption crops, with the PDF text layer used only as a cross-check.
